_comment: Judgement calls: where neither a creature's level nor its danger score (see [Threat] in AdventurersGuild.ini) ranks it right. "races" is keyed by race editor ID and "actors" by actor editor ID; tools/EspGen resolves them into threat.resolved.json, which is the file the game reads and the one to edit in an install. atLeast: never ranked below this. fromLevel: atLeast only applies from this level up (one race, several tiers). atMost: never ranked above this, and it replaces the ceiling the creature's keywords give it (wildlife stops at B). Rank letters E D C B A S. Rank S is never reached by level alone: a race or an actor that is "atLeast": "S" here is S, and so is a dragon from the A level up; anything else has to prove it (at the S level, with a danger score of ScoreS or more) or stops at A.

GiantRace._why: never a pushover, whatever level another mod gives it

DraugrRace._why: level 30 and up are the Deathlords: ebony weapons and shouts that their level (rank C) does not show. Draugr fight with carried weapons, so the danger score cannot lift them

DragonPriestRace._why: level 50 (rank A), a caster, so no danger score: the top of the draugr crypts

DLC2NetchRace._why: a lot of health and a real shock, but docile

HorseRace._why: its health alone would score D

AlduinRace._why: the World-Eater, at whatever level the player meets him (he is 1.2 times the player's)

DLC2AcolyteDragonPriestRace._why: the dragon priests of Solstheim, as the ones of Skyrim

SkeeverRace._why: small wildlife, here and below: never more than a nuisance, whatever level a list gives it

MammothRace._why: big game and trolls, here and below: the game calls them wildlife, which stops at B; these may reach A, never S

DLC2Miraak._why: the First Dragonborn: he is 1.1 times the player's level

Odahviing._why: takes the level of whichever dragon suits the player

DLC2EbonyWarrior._why: level 80, and a person: no danger score to prove it with
